Divinity Candy
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 18, 2009 - 11:40pm

Ingredients




3 cups sugar
2/3 cup Karo
 cup water
Pinch of salt
3 egg whites, beaten until very stiff
1 teaspoon almond extract
2 teaspoons vanilla extract
Food coloring, if desired
1 cup pecans, broken in sm. pieces

Preparation

1 Combine first 4 ingredients and cook until syrup "spins a thread", constantly stirring. Add syrup slowly to egg whites, beating as you add. When divinity is almost firm, add rest of ingredients.
